cohort: 90 patients undergoing elective or emergency caesarean section at Kamineni Academy of Medical Sciences and Research Centre, LB Nagar, Hyderabad
finding: Both intrathecal clonidine and the combination of clonidine and fentanyl enhanced the effectiveness of intraoperative analgesia, with the combination providing superior intraoperative and sustained postoperative analgesia compared to clonidine alone.
